method: Blender 5.2 DECIMATE collapse, triangulate enabled, target ratio 3427/6431; vertex group weights only reducible interior vertices; all true principal-axis outline and nonmanifold edge endpoint vertices protected by ray-tested silhouette classification.

geometry_deviation_mm.sampling: Both directions include every mesh vertex and every triangle centroid; closest distance to the opposing BVH surface. Blender coordinates treated as metres for this 1:4.5-scale source.

outline_proof.definition: Principal-axis true silhouette edges: adjacent facet normals straddle the view plane and paired +/-15 micrometre perpendicular ray samples disagree. Every endpoint vertex is protected during Decimate. The exact projected convex hull is also compared in local YZ, XZ, XY planes at 1e-9 units.
